_meta.notes: Modern (snake_case singleton) tool names. Legacy aliases (fs_read, fs_write, execute_bash, use_aws, use_subagent, listDirectory, fileSearch) are accepted by the kiro runtime but not emitted by smith. Permission groups absent from the mapping (skill, external_directory, question, doom_loop) are silently skipped except 'skill' which the kiro translator handles via skill:// resource emission.
